newsitem.title: GERMANY: Conti sees significant rise in 97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Conti sees significant rise in 97 earnings.

text.p: German tyre manufacturer Continental AG said on Wednesday that it expected a significant rise in net profit in full-year 1997 and that sales would rise about five percent to 11 billion marks ($6.4 billion).

Management board chairman Hubertus von Gruenberg said that pre-tax profits in the first five months of 1997 rose 47 percent to 185 million marks, while sales rose 2.3 percent to 4.4 billion marks in the same period.

Continental shares were up 1.10 marks, or 2.83 percent, at 40 marks as the figures emerged. The shares had risen even higher earlier on after reports in the Platow Brief newsletter of a higher earnings outlook for 1997.
